{{Quote|Hey, get that. Ol' Shiv has the shivers. Heh.|Shiv, in a letter to Flanker|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />}}
'''Shiv''' was a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the war, Shiv enjoyed writing to [[Hatchmate|fellow]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Flanker]], even after Flanker's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Shiv and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were assigned to [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] to field-test an assortment of subzero gear. While on the planet, his squad encountered an elusive and dangerous [[Species/Legends|species]] they nicknamed the "[[Talz/Legends|ice men]]." The creatures killed any of the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] patrols they encountered. Shiv and his [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Mag (clone trooper)|Mag]], were later killed by the ice men while inspecting one of the station's outer [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]]. The rest of the clones stationed in Glid Station, along with all the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] at the nearby [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] base, were killed by the ice men as well. A [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] investigation later discovered that the ice men were actually a [[Talz village/Legends|colony]] of Talz that had been attacked by the Separatists and that Glid Station was caught in the ensuing conflict.

==History==
===Orto Plutonia===
{{Quote|Flanker, things aren't going to well now. Commander Mag and I were inspecting an outer sensor, but our Freeco bikes froze solid.|Shiv, writing to Flanker|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />}}
[[File:Clone_snowtroopers.png|thumb|left|200px|Shiv on Orto Plutonia]]
Shiv was the taken name of a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]]<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]<ref name="clone troopers" /> to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="DB-clone troopers">{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}}</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Shiv enjoyed writing to [[Hatchmate|fellow]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Flanker]], even after Flanker's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /> Shiv and the rest of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were stationed at [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]] on the frozen planet of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> Orto Plutonia was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the sovereign [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], populated by the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantorans]], which had remained allied to the Republic during the Clone Wars.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref> Shiv and his squad were tasked with testing experimental cold weather equipment, including the [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|CK-6 swoop]] [[Speeder bike/Legends|bike]], nicknamed the "Freeco bike." During their [[Desert/Legends|desert]] training, Shiv and Flanker had always thought that Shiv would be shipped off to a [[Water/Legends|water]] planet, so Shiv found it amusing that he was stationed instead on an ice planet.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

Shiv's stay at Glid Station was filled with many problems. His squad's [[Ration cube/Legends|rations]] were not shipped in insulated canisters and, due to the extreme [[Temperature/Legends|cold]], were frozen solid. This forced the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to boil their rations, which took away the little flavor the rations had. In addition, the Freeco bikes would freeze up if not constantly maintained.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

Matters grew worse when Shiv's squad started to encounter a very dangerous and mysterious [[Species/Legends|species]], which they nicknamed the "ice men." All the patrols that had apparently encountered the ice men were [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> Although there was a nearby Separatist base on the planet,<ref name="The Clone Wars: Trespass" /> Shiv and his squad never encountered any [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], but they still tried to stay in fighting shape by building snowmen that resembled [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s; [[B2-series super battle droid/Legends|B2 battle droids]]; and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], the [[Supreme Commander]] of [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]], and used them as target practice.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

===Death at the hands of the "ice men"===
[[File:Shiv.png|thumb|right|200px|Shiv writes in his datapad shortly before his death.]]
One [[Standard day/Legends|night]], Shiv and his [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Mag (clone trooper)|Mag]], were inspecting an outer [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] when their Freeco bikes froze up. The pair was forced to spend the night on the frozen tundra until Glid Station could send an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] to pick them up at dawn. The clones set up a small camp and a tent, deciding they would take turns guarding the camp and [[Sleep/Legends|sleeping]]. While Mag was taking his shift of guarding the camp, Shiv decided to stay up and wrote a letter to Flanker on a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to calm his nerves. While Shiv was lamenting about the pair's predicament in his letter, Mag came into the tent to find that Shiv was writing instead of resting for his turn on guard duty. Soon after Mag entered the tent, a group of ice men attacked the camp, ripping open the tent and killing Mag. As Shiv tried to grab a [[DC-17 hand blaster/Legends|DC-17 hand blaster]] to defend himself, he too was attacked and killed by the ice men.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />

After Shiv and Mag were killed by the ice men, the snow creatures attacked both the Separatist outpost and Glid Station, destroying all the battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] stationed at the separate bases. When the Republic lost contact with Glid station, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] sent an investigation party, led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to Orto Plutonia to find out what had happened to the outpost. The team was accompanied by representatives from Pantora: [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] and Galactic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] investigation discovered that the "ice men" were actually a peaceful [[Talz village/Legends|group]] of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] that had been attacked by the Separatist battle droids, and the Glid base had been caught in the middle of the resulting conflict.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Trespass" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I know you're not much for letters, Flanker, but writing them relaxes me.|Shiv|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" />}}
When nervous, Shiv found that writing letters relaxed him. Some of these letters were written to Flanker, even after his [[hatchmate]] was killed on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. However, Shiv was reluctant to tell others that he still wrote letters to Flanker, such as when Mag asked him who Flanker was. Shiv also had a sense of humor, which he showed in his last letter to Flanker before his death.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> As a clone of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]],<ref name="DB-clone troopers" /> Shiv had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], black [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> and, like all clone troopers, stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="clone troopers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shiv made his first and only appearance in the six-page [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (webcomics)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' webcomic]] [[The Clone Wars: Cold Snap|''Cold Snap'']], which led directly into "[[Trespass]],"<ref name="The Clone Wars: Cold Snap" /> an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series.<ref name="Trespass Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode015.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Trespass}}</ref>
